changed_behaviour: Schema/migration 2026_10_07_000006_share_links_v1: v_node_shares gains role_key varchar(32), role_version smallint (default 1), audience varchar(16) (default anyone), token_generation integer (default 1); permissions, permissions_version, level, require_login, allow_discovery are dropped. Conversion: 65->reader, 97->commenter, 1->previewer (v1 bits) and legacy v0 1->reader, 33->commenter; require_login true->authenticated else anyone; any other mask -> UpgradePreflightException. Guarded, resumable, reversible down().

Migration 2026_10_07_000005 (applied): share-mask steps get a hasColumn guard so a fresh install (new node_shares shape) no longer reads permissions; no behavioural change for upgraded databases (deviation, logged).

ShareLinkInput{role, audience, scope, expiresAt, password, maxUses}; ShareLinkUpdate{expiresAt, password, maxUses, audience, removePassword, removeMaxUses}; ShareOperations::update/rotate; role/audience rules in Sharing\ShareLinkRules (previewer/reader/commenter any audience, writer only authenticated|tenant, organizer/owner never) -> ShareRoleNotAllowedException; policy TTL -> ShareLinkTtlExceededException (create/update and at every resolve).

ShareResolver: audience anyone|authenticated|tenant (tenant = authenticated + TenantResolver::current() equals drive tenant, else opaque 404), role as the only source of abilities (ShareContext::role), signed link session (generation-bound) so a redemption counts once per session, policy TTL re-check on each access, refresh() re-checks role/audience/generation/password.

Redemption moves from download to session open (ResolveShareToken + RedeemShareLinkAction + atomic conditional UPDATE bound to token_generation); previewer download -> 403 permission_denied; rotate: new token, token_generation+1, old token 404.

HTTP: StoreShareLinkRequest on role/audience, new PATCH nodes/{node}/shares/{share} and POST nodes/{node}/shares/{share}/rotate, NodeShareResource role/audience/generation; Filament NodeShareResource and @vaulter/vue client/types/panel on the new fields.
